ai.title: SDK: Fix reasoning.exclude suppression
ai.summary: Fixed bug where `reasoning.exclude` option failed to suppress reasoning tokens in `promptAiSdkStream`. Logic now correctly checks provider options for `openrouter` and `codebuff` before yielding reasoning deltas. Changes confined to `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`.

eli5.text: If you turned on the option to hide the assistant's private thinking notes, the streaming response now actually stops showing them, instead of printing them anyway. This affects only the two sources the tool reads from for this setting, and only while the reply is being generated live. It's fixed today, so the next streamed request will honor the setting correctly.
